label: Запись
description: A 10-sentence usage card for запись (recording; note).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Запись' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative case, acting as the subject. 'Концерта' is a genitive specifying which recording.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Запись' is the direct object of 'удалил'. For feminine soft-sign nouns the accusative equals the nominative, and 'важную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Записи' is genitive because the negated 'нет' requires the genitive. Feminine soft-sign nouns take -и in the genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Записи' is the genitive form linked to 'качество', expressing whose quality. Feminine soft-sign nouns share the -и ending here.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Записи' is the dative form governed by 'уделить внимание'. 'Каждой' agrees in the feminine dative singular.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Записью' is the instrumental form governed by 'гордиться'. Feminine soft-sign nouns end in -ью in the instrumental singular.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Записи' is the prepositional form after 'в', naming the location of the sound. Feminine soft-sign nouns take -и in the prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Запись' is nominative as the subject of 'понравилась'. 'Новая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'всем' takes the dative.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Записи' is the plural accusative direct object of 'хранит'. For inanimate feminine nouns the plural accusative equals the nominative plural in -и.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Запись' is nominative as the subject of 'помогает'. 'Чёткая' is the agreeing feminine adjective describing the note.
